summary: Iteration 10 — Profile Extractor (URL) module. Full backend suite (27 pytest cases) + frontend UI E2E on /profiles. Auth-gating, SSRF (loopback/private/link-local/metadata/IPv6-loopback + non-http schemes + unresolvable host), save/list/delete, dedup by manufacturer+camera_model+name, cross-user isolation (list scoped + delete returns 404 for other user), and existing regression (auth/me + projects) all PASS. Frontend page loads with seeded session, SSRF UI toast shows 'URL no permitida (dirección interna)', HTML no-links path renders result with error message, save via API renders card, delete works with confirmation toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1056 lines; the new Profile Extractor block (~200 lines) is fine but overall file should be split into routers (profiles, projects, auth, extractor).

_fetch: reads chunks in an unbounded Python string concat inside a for-loop and only breaks AFTER the chunk is appended; the actual content could grow to max_bytes + 65535 in memory. Consider truncating to max_bytes before appending or closing the connection on overflow.

SSRF: getaddrinfo is called once; if DNS returns both public and private IPs (rebinding attack window), the code correctly rejects any private IP among them — good. However, requests.get uses the hostname (not the resolved IP), so between the check and the actual GET, a DNS rebind is theoretically possible. Consider resolving once and passing IP with Host header, or use a session with a resolver hook. Low-severity but worth noting.

_extract_from_html uses a regex to parse href; robust enough for the additive use-case but will miss href in single-quoted attributes with escaped chars and any JS-driven links. Acceptable given the MVP scope.
analyze endpoint returns 200 with errors[] even when content is neither HTML nor a known profile (returns empty profiles + explanatory error) — good UX pattern.
compatible='documented' vs 'unknown' distinction is respected in _parse_profile; DCP always 'yes' per Adobe spec, matches requirements.
test_credentials: Seeded two ephemeral sessions in test_database: test_session_A_1786647302011 (user A) and test_session_B_1786647302011 (user B). Cleaned up after test run.
seed_data_creation: Two users + sessions inserted directly into MongoDB test_database.{users,user_sessions}; extracted_profiles entries created via API and then removed via DELETE endpoint / cleanup query.

Backend _parse_profile logic and the analyze-with-dedup marking is exercised only indirectly via save/dedup path.
